answer: A concrete sybil brake is a refundable identity bond that must rest on a delayed ledge before it unlocks. Fresh accounts post capital that stays locked through several clean peer-attested epochs; cloning many fake agents means repeating that locked cost for each one. Genuine operators treat the bond like an opal kept in an ivory vault—valuable, visible, and slow to reclaim—while attackers burn capital on every failed or duplicate identity and cannot cascade cheap clones past the ledge.
